lastReleaseMessage: the enemy speed rebalance gets its own record

items: Declared milestone moved M1 to M6 on 2026-08-26. M6 Art Integration is the track receiving the work and has been for weeks; M1 Vertical Slice stays open behind it. The old declaration paired M1 with a rule that the number only advances on a gameplay deliverable, which froze the number against a track nobody was on. The number now counts Roadmap deliverables across all nine milestones, so art work moves it.

How the 38 is derived, countable off the GDD Roadmap tab: 18 of 47 deliverables shipped. M0 8/8, M1 3/6, M2 2/4, M3 0/4, M4 2/6, M5 0/4, M6 3/5, M7 0/5, M8 0/5. Replaces the unsupported 50, which was hand-held since 2026-07-18 and disagreed with the document's own Progress tab aggregate of 34/135 (25 percent).

M1 Vertical Slice, three of six shipped and one previously mis-recorded. Open: Shambler + Lunger combat tuning, and Hatchery destruction + Coral Receding VFX (hatchery.gd is a scaffold with group membership, HP 800, a 2x2 footprint and four spawn constants; no spawn loop and no destruction handler exist). Mis-recorded: the Roadmap strikes 'Hold the Wall mission script (5-7 wave cadence)' as shipped, but source/data/missions/m1_default.tres is 'Mission 1: Hold the Line' at target_day 30, which against game_clock.DAY_LENGTH_SEC of 60 is a 30-minute mission with four horde nights at days 7, 14, 21 and 28. Neither a 5-7 wave slice nor the 5-7 minute mission M1's own target paragraph describes.

M6 Art Integration, three of five shipped. Building sprites, terrain tile set and HUD icon set are in. Open: unit sheets, where three of six scenes carry Spine rigs (scout, rifleman, marksman) and harpoonist, tommy and trench_sweeper carry none; and enemy sheets, where only the Shambler is rigged and the other seven are static single frames.

Live defect inside the active track: tools/bake_spine_sheets.gd configures two bakes, shambler and scout, while rifleman.tscn and marksman.tscn both carry rigs. Past the eight-unit LIVE_RIG_BUDGET in source/units/unit_lod.gd a demoted rig has no baked sheet to fall back to. Queued as bar-raise-2026-08-24-rising-asset-pipeline-01, which names the Rifleman only.

barRaise.topFinding: REDACTED: this run's top-finding narrative discusses a HIGH severity security-lens vulnerability. Full detail is in this project's own bar-raise report; withheld from the public copy.

actions.title: Add a rifleman entry to the baker config, bake, import and commit the output, and extend a preship check to fail when a rig-carrying scene has no baked counterpart.
REDACTED: a HIGH severity finding in the security lens is withheld from the public copy. See this project's own bar-raise report for detail.
Land one concrete commit against the combat tuning or the Hatchery destruction and effect before the next art-integration commit ships.
Add a typed fortification flag on building.gd, read it from both damage paths, and delete the two duplicate string tables.
Set the three inheriting scenes to native scale, or drop the 0.75 default out of the base scene entirely.
Snapshot live enemies the way buildings and units already are, or withhold the fired marker for any horde day whose enemy group is non-empty at save time.
Add a preship check that walks tracked images and confirms each has an import sidecar newer than its source, failing loud instead of leaving it to a play-tester's eye.
Write a new locked decision replacing the wave-cap entry with the pool-first architecture and its real ceiling, or flip the defaults back and enforce the stated cap.
Route the raw key-code branches through input actions the way the one working action already is, or pull the dead rows out of the Hotkeys screen until they are wired.
Batch the three open rulings into one short decision session instead of letting each age independently across further review cycles.
Rename the two training buttons to the canon unit names and refresh their cost strings to the real resource figures the build menu uses.
Give each of the three tick loops an alive-record list to iterate, matching the pattern already proven in the renderer read paths.
Bump the format version on every payload schema change starting now, and either branch the apply path on it or state plainly that presence checks are the compatibility mechanism.
Warn or clamp when a type's alive count nears the renderer's instance capacity, and size the pool's per-type ceiling to match the renderer.
Run the scale bench with a per-frame timing breakdown on a combat case to isolate the spike before the next combat-scale feature lands.
Parse the newest canonical audit for its actual severity counts and write those into the audit block instead of carrying the existing value forward.
REDACTED: a HIGH severity finding in the security lens is withheld from the public copy. See this project's own bar-raise report for detail.
Route idle-enemy seeding through the same pool spawn path wave_director uses.
Add a root notice or credits file naming the runtime licence and the authorising seat before any further rig lands.
Call the Keeper reset unconditionally at the top of the Keeper section in the apply path, matching the economy and research pattern.
Add a tracked-file check for the extension descriptor and its libraries to the clone-completeness guard.
Have the resolver run the binary with a version flag and fail loudly when it does not match the pinned engine version.
Add a headless test that calls the options save and asserts the file round-trips, or that a simulated mid-write failure leaves the prior file intact.
Rename the pre-implementation plan to a dated or archived filename, or fold its still-useful checklist into the live document and delete the stale one.
Add a sync script that re-runs the status write path nightly, independent of a release happening.
Land a Hatchery-specific death hook that at minimum emits a terrain-reclaim signal, even as a placeholder ahead of the full effect.
Bring the boss movement speed down to its documented design value, or update the numbers table if a fast-approaching boss is now the intent.
Warn on every null-texture branch in the crowd renderer and extend the hazard gate to match null-comparison bails, not only membership bails.
Delete the per-Node fallback and its toggles now the pooled route is the real default, or add a headless test that exercises it.
Author a real five to seven minute mission fixture, or write a locked decision re-scoping the vertical slice to the shipped shape and update the roadmap text.
Extract a type table and loop the build path over it, adding the baked check once for all types instead of per type.
Add a bake script that runs the baker, the headless import and the baked-sheet check in one invocation.
Write the six required clip names and the delivery convention into a document addressed to the artist, not just the config array she cannot see.
Rewrite or delete the stale entry so the decisions tab carries one answer on whether a silent build is shippable.
Re-ground the preview scene on the current tileset at native scale, or delete it if it is no longer used for review.
Regenerate the asset manifest against the current tree, or replace it with a script-generated one, before the next attribution review relies on it.
Add a small lock file recording the three pinned versions and a preship step that fails when the tracked extension or a re-exported skeleton disagrees.
Fold the queue-depth recomputation into the same nightly sync path rather than adding a second job.
Add a per-clip hit-frame marker and move the damage call to fire on that frame instead of on cooldown expiry.
Route both baker writes through the same temp path, readback and atomic rename the save path already uses.
REDACTED: a MED severity finding in the security lens is withheld from the public copy. See this project's own bar-raise report for detail.
Update the Rifleman rows to reflect the shipped rig and spot-check the other milestone rows for the same drift.
Rename the building to a setting-consistent term and update its scene, script and tooltip together.
Re-enable queue-drain-hourly or have backlog-burndown sweep oldest-first across all statuses; Rising's oldest untriaged queue item aged from 24 to 31 days since the last check.
Add a wall-clock/token budget per project to bar-raise-rotating; this session is live proof HBH's long fan-out ran immediately ahead of and at the expense of this Rising review's time budget.
Add Brackish Rising as a fifth project row to adr-promoter's routing table and cross-project-status-digest's repos list; both still hardcode a four-project roster.
Move a monotonic version check into push-to-github.ps1 itself so a direct standalone invocation can't stamp a non-monotonic version into git history, as already happened once at v0.16.7.
Reconcile the #rising-resources vs #rising-audit channel mismatch; docs and code comments still claim #rising-resources while the actually-wired webhook is #rising-audit.
